title: Machine learning of charges and long-range interactions from energies and forces
access_depth: indexed publisher abstract/results/introduction; direct publisher open blocked
contribution: Latent Ewald Summation augments atomistic learning with long-range electrostatic structure using energies and forces.
limitations: This pass did not independently reproduce benchmarks; learned partial charges are model-dependent latent quantities.

title: Kim and Cheng: Long-range electrostatics for machine learning interatomic potentials is easier than we thought
access_depth: author full HTML; design principles and limitations read
contribution: Authors articulate Coulomb-form and latent-charge learning principles, while discussing charge transfer, interfaces and scaling.
limitations: Perspective by method authors, not an independent universal ranking; local features alone cannot model arbitrary global charge equilibration.

title: Accurate and Scalable Continuum Electrostatics for Large Biomolecular Systems: The pyDelPhi Poisson–Boltzmann Framework
access_depth: publisher abstract plus author-university full PDF fetched; abstract and numerical framework sampled
contribution: Python/Numba framework extends established continuum electrostatics to multiple dielectric representations and CPU/GPU execution.
limitations: Online publication 2025-12-24; journal issue 2026. No independent accuracy, runtime or platform replication. Accessible author copy: https://bpb-us-e2.wpmucdn.com/sites.ua.edu/dist/e/242/files/2026/01/JCIM26.pdf

title: Neural network Poisson–Boltzmann electrostatics for biomolecular interactions
access_depth: indexed publisher and author-affiliated HKU abstract
contribution: Neural variational approach to dielectric-interface Poisson–Boltzmann solutions and molecular electrostatic free energies.
limitations: Online metadata 2025-10-11; journal issue 2026-01-01. Abstract-level reading; neural residual accuracy is not automatically observable accuracy.

title: Krempaský et al.: Altermagnetic lifting of Kramers spin degeneracy
access_depth: indexed publisher PDF abstract and introductory scope
contribution: Photoemission and calculations provide evidence for altermagnetic spin splitting in compensated MnTe.
limitations: Material-specific evidence; zero net magnetization alone is insufficient to identify an altermagnet.

title: Sprague et al.: Observation of Altermagnetic Spin-Splitting in an Intercalated Transition Metal Dichalcogenide
access_depth: indexed publisher abstract/introduction; direct open blocked
contribution: ARPES, magnetometry and DFT study Co1/4TaSe2 with reported ordering near 178 K.
limitations: A reported material demonstration is not a general proof of robust room-temperature memory operation.

title: Electrical manipulation and detection of perpendicular altermagnetic order via a proximitized Dirac semimetal
access_depth: indexed publisher abstract; direct open blocked
contribution: PtTe2/CrSb heterostructure demonstrates electrical reading and switching of perpendicular order.
limitations: Abstract-level coverage; endurance, integration yield and broad technology superiority have not been audited here.

title: Yang et al.: Embedded Skyrmion Bags in Thin Films of Chiral Magnets
access_depth: publisher HTML abstract, topology definition and selected experimental limitations
contribution: Imaging and micromagnetics examine embedded magnetic textures with tunable topological charge in FeGe thin plates.
limitations: Stability is finite and depends on thickness, temperature and fields; topology is not immunity to arbitrary perturbations.

title: Yang–Mills group: Pure Yang–Mills results and verification
access_depth: repository README, scope, package structure and reproduction instructions
contribution: November assessment endorses a Wightman-axiom scaling-limit construction from four-dimensional Wilson lattice theory for simple compact gauge groups.
limitations: The assessment explicitly excludes uniqueness of infinite-volume limit and a mass-gap proof. This atlas has not rebuilt the Lean package.

title: Shepherding Committee: 3rd Statement about Quantum Yang–Mills Theory
contribution: Committee describes the release and assessment of the OpenAI existence construction.
limitations: Committee endorsement is evidence about review status; it does not extend the theorem to a mass gap or other theories.

title: LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA: GWTC-5.0 — Tests of General Relativity
access_depth: author abstract and official collaboration summary
contribution: Seven test families applied to a cumulative 168 high-significance events find overall agreement with GR within stated statistical/modeling limits.
limitations: Preprint status on the official publication list inspected; waveform/noise systematics and selected-event thresholds matter. Agreement is not a theorem excluding every alternative theory.

title: DESI DR2 Results IV: Alcock–Paczyński Measurements from the Lyman Alpha Forest and Cosmological Constraints
access_depth: author HTML abstract, conclusions and model-comparison section
contribution: Full-shape Ly-alpha analysis adds AP information and refines cosmological distances at effective redshift 2.33.
limitations: The individual Ly-alpha point shifts toward LambdaCDM, whereas combined-dataset preferences remain model/dataset dependent; this is neither proof of evolving dark energy nor proof against it.

title: Aziz and Howl: Classical theories of gravity produce entanglement
access_depth: author abstract and selected discussion; v3 dated 2026-07-01
contribution: Argues that selected classical-gravity/QFT constructions can produce entanglement, altering interpretation of proposed mediator tests.
limitations: Interpretation depends on what is classical and on locality/matter assumptions; this is an argument to audit, not an experimental discovery that gravity is classical.

title: The Hawking–Page transition at weak coupling
contribution: Reports a negative three-loop quartic coefficient for weakly coupled N=4 super Yang–Mills on S3, implying a first-order transition in that setting.
limitations: Preprint marked primarily AI-generated and partly human-understood; not independently recomputed here and not a proof of first order at every coupling.

title: The spinless modular bootstrap at large central charge
contribution: Reports an optimal leading slope for a restricted spinless modular-bootstrap problem, using logarithmic-potential methods.
limitations: Assumes unitary compact 2D CFTs with c>1 and no extra currents; statement constrains a method and does not construct a full quantum-gravity theory. Proof not replayed here.

title: Qiao et al.: Acoustic phonon phase gates with number-resolving phonon detection
access_depth: author HTML abstract, conclusion and measurement-correction section
contribution: Demonstrates phase control and phonon-number detection with superconducting circuits; reports 98.1% noise-floor-limited HOM visibility.
limitations: Interference visibility is not an end-to-end logical gate fidelity; measurement correction and experimental conditioning matter.

title: A thorium-229 optical nuclear clock with feedback loop
access_depth: indexed publisher abstract and methods excerpts; publication date cross-checked with PubMed
contribution: Closed-loop stabilization to a thorium nuclear transition links nuclear spectroscopy to operating frequency references.
limitations: Do not equate a nuclear transition's potential with demonstrated superiority over all optical atomic clocks; systematic shifts and reproducibility remain separate metrics.

title: Xia et al.: Acoustic topological Jackiw–Rebbi states at symmetry broken interfaces
access_depth: publisher full HTML results and experimental section
contribution: Engineered metagrating combines a non-Hermitian effective model with directional acoustic interface radiation.
limitations: Demonstrated around 42.2 kHz with a narrow reported bandwidth; local directional intensity enhancement does not establish energy gain.

title: Ding et al.: Absorbing exceptional point of coherent vortex beams
access_depth: indexed publisher abstract; direct open blocked
contribution: Acoustic metasurfaces realize coherent absorption at a non-Hermitian scattering degeneracy using vortex beams.
limitations: Abstract-level reading; coherent phase, loss and illumination conditions are required, and absorption is not generation.
